summary: Project to ensure the production app displays the user-provided chart values by updating the backend chart data source to match the provided 13×11 table.
architectural_notes: Production app chart values come from a hard-coded backend function (e.g., getBackendChart), which can differ from UI draft data unless updated.
known_issues: Chart values shown in the live app do not match the user-provided dataset or the draft because the backend is still using an old hard-coded chart.

new_feature_requests.summary: Replace the hard-coded backend chart (getBackendChart) with the user-provided 13×11 table so production matches draft and provided values

Replace the hard-coded backend Callaway chart in `backend/main.mo` (currently returned by `getBackendChart()`) with the user-provided 13-row dataset so that production calculations and chart values match the exact provided grossScore→holesToDeduct pairs (including 0.5 increments and placeholder cells with grossScore=0 / worstHoles=0).

Update backend chart exposure and lookup so that `getCallawayChart()` returns correct ranges and values for the updated chart, and scoring uses the same updated chart semantics (i.e., range-based matching rather than the current `grossScoreTo = lowerBound + 4` heuristic if it does not reflect the real chart groups).
Align or remove the backend `getGrossToDeductionTable()` output so it is consistent with the updated backend chart data (no stale ranges/values that contradict the chart used by `calculateCallaway`).
